title: ToolCUA: Towards Optimal GUI-Tool Path Orchestration for Computer Use Agents
abstract: arXiv:2605.12481v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Computer Use Agents (CUAs) can act through both atomic GUI actions, such as click and type, and high-level tool calls, such as API-based file operations, but this hybrid action space often leaves them uncertain about when to continue with GUI actions or switch to tools, leading to suboptimal execution paths. This difficulty stems from the scarcity of high-quality interleaved GUI-Tool trajectories, the cost and brittleness of collecting real tool trajectories, and the lack of trajectory-level supervision for GUI-Tool path selection. In this paper, we propose ToolCUA, an end-to-end agent designed to learn optimal GUI-Tool path selection through a staged training paradigm. We first introduce an Interleaved GUI-Tool Trajectory Scaling Pipeline that repurposes abundant static GUI trajectories and synthesizes a grounded tool library, enabling diverse GUI-Tool trajectories without manual engineering or real tool-trajectory collection. translated_title: ToolCUA：面向计算机使用智能体的最优GUI-工具路径编排
translated_abstract: 计算机使用智能体（Computer Use Agents, CUAs）既可以通过原子化的GUI操作（如点击和输入）执行动作，也可以通过高层工具调用（如基于API的文件操作）执行动作，但这种混合动作空间常常使它们不确定何时应继续使用GUI操作、何时应切换到工具，从而导致次优的执行路径。这一困难源于高质量交错式GUI-工具轨迹的稀缺、收集真实工具轨迹的成本高昂且脆弱，以及缺乏针对GUI-工具路径选择的轨迹级监督。在本文中，我们提出ToolCUA，这是一个端到端智能体，旨在通过分阶段训练范式学习最优的GUI-工具路径选择。我们首先引入了一个交错式GUI-工具轨迹扩展流水线，该流水线复用大量静态GUI轨迹并合成一个有据可依的工具库，从而无需人工工程或真实工具轨迹收集即可生成多样化的GUI-工具轨迹。我们随后……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: ToolCUA通过分阶段训练范式和交错式GUI-工具轨迹扩展流水线，使计算机使用智能体能够在GUI操作与工具调用之间学习最优路径选择，且无需人工工程或真实工具轨迹收集。
en_tdlr: ToolCUA proposes a staged training paradigm with an interleaved GUI-Tool trajectory scaling pipeline, enabling computer use agents to learn optimal path selection between GUI actions and tool calls without manual engineering or real tool-trajectory collection.
